title: Quantum ESPRESSO simulation programs
status_detail: Generic Quantum ESPRESSO simulation umbrella. The completed non-scientific integration boundary, inactive Pranab Das hands-on tutorial campaign, and inactive QE 7.2 bundled-examples campaign are separate children. No scientific simulation or protected execution is active.
objective: Coordinate named Quantum ESPRESSO simulation campaigns and the shared non-scientific integration boundary without conflating tutorial provenance, project production calculations, or execution authority.
authorized_scope: Contain separately named Quantum ESPRESSO campaign and integration Tasks without owning their scientific settings or implementation details.
Require every scientific campaign and invocation to retain its own source provenance, exact preflight, protected-execution authorization, workspace, and disposition.
Keep Pranab Das tutorial observations, QE-distribution bundled-example observations, bulk-silicon production evidence, and other Quantum ESPRESSO campaigns distinct.
completion_criteria: Every child campaign or integration Task retains a distinct identity, provenance boundary, and completion or deferral disposition.
No child is activated merely by parent containment or a static task-graph edge.
Tutorial, diagnostic, and production evidence remain explicitly classified and are not substituted for one another.
exclusions: This umbrella does not authorize Quantum ESPRESSO, Wannier90, MPI, remote, cluster, cloud, or other protected execution.
It does not select pseudopotentials, scientific settings, tutorial sources, dependencies, or production acceptance criteria.
It does not imply that a tutorial pass establishes project numerical verification or scientific validation.
